anchors.description: Width of the black side-by-side refrigerator front face, between the outer left and right front door edges at mid height
anchors.visible_evidence: Both vertical outer edges of the black refrigerator's front door face are visible from about y=30 to y=370: the left edge against the beige wall and memo organizer, the right edge against the wood cabinets/backsplash. Mid-height points lie on the same flat front face.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Standard freestanding side-by-side refrigerators are 35.5-36.25 in (0.90-0.92 m) wide; uncommon 33 in or 42 in models and slight front-face tilt could shift the true width by a few percent.

anchors.description: Height of the black side-by-side refrigerator front face, from its top front edge to its bottom front edge
anchors.visible_evidence: The refrigerator's top front edge is visible just below the wood cabinet over it (near y=25 at center x≈333), and the bottom front edge is visible where the black doors meet the tile floor (near y=369 at x≈338); both points lie on the same vertical front plane.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Standard side-by-side refrigerator heights are 68.5-71.5 in (1.74-1.82 m); the visible door face excludes small top/bottom trim gaps, so the interval is widened to ±0.08 m.
